items.heading: Ndole
details: Key ingredients: bitterleaf, groundnuts, dried fish, beef, shrimp
Boil bitterleaf to reduce bitterness, then chop finely.
Grind roasted groundnuts into a smooth paste.
Simmer the groundnut paste with beef, dried fish and shrimp.
Fold in the bitterleaf and cook until the sauce thickens.

items.heading: Poulet DG
details: Key ingredients: chicken, plantain, vegetables, garlic
Fry chunks of chicken and ripe plantain separately until golden.
Saute garlic, peppers and vegetables in the same pan.
Combine the chicken and plantain with the vegetables.
Toss everything together briefly and serve hot.

details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.

Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
